The West is handing over the world's economy to China. To China, for God's sake: an unimaginably brutal totalitarian regime. 

And why? 
So our hypocritical elite can continue to style themselves as planetary saviors?

Enough demoralizing doom-crying. 

Enough despicable praying in public. 

Enough subverting our children's future. 

Enough pointless impoverishing of Europe and Australia. 

Enough bloody Net Zero idiocy. 

Enough.

Everybody knows the deserts are expanding.

Everybody knows that climate change threatens our food supplies.

LIES. LIES. LIES. LIES. LIES. LIES.

The planet is greener, by an area 3x that of the Amazon. The Sahara is shrinking fast. Crops are thriving like never before.

Enough Net Zero posturing. Enough demoralizing the young.

To hell with the false prophets of environmental doom.

Friedrich Nietzsche. Beyond Good and Evil (1866).

You might like to think that if the rape gang (sexual conquest gang) scandal had come to your attention you certainly would not have denied what was happening, or remained silent.

Stop. Dare to really ask yourself (instead of just assuming your virtue):

You would've put your career on the line?
